marketing_wrapper: Lavender-tinted light backdrop #edecfa, Mercury logo or 'Business/Personal' tag chips, a regular-weight grotesk caption, then a frameless UI panel (~40pt top corners, hairline border, no bezel) that fades out at the bottom, ~65-70% UI. 02, 03 and 06 add floating glass cards over a blurred copy of the screen; 05 is mostly receipt photography.

typography.display: Custom grotesk at regular weight for both captions and in-app titles ('Move Money', 'Payments'); consistent with the text record's Arcadia (unsure); wordmark in wide tracked caps
typography.body: custom: same family (Arcadia per text record, unsure)
typography.numerals: lining, regular weight, superscript cents; tabular unsure
typography.weights: Uniformly light: balances, titles and amounts all regular (~400-480), no bold anywhere
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; MERCURY wordmark uppercase with wide tracking; normal tracking in UI

palette.accent_strategy: One indigo/lavender family for all interactive chrome (filled primary, tonal pills, progress, chart); green and pink-red only on flow arrows and available balance.
palette.source: palette.json 01-06 (#edecfa ~30% canvas in every image, #f9f8fe/#f3f2fc surfaces), 04 (#e3e2f2 23% tonal panel/pills, #565071 dark purple card art); ink and accents visual

shape.radius_language: large and pill: floating cards ~28pt, panel ~40pt, all buttons pills, card art ~16pt, limit panel ~10pt
shape.borders_shadows: Hairline lavender borders; large soft shadows only under floating glass cards
shape.materials: Frosted glass popovers and cards over blurred content (account switcher, recurring payment card, upload pill)

liquid_glass_visible: yes: the account switcher popover, the floating 'Green Thumb LLC' card and the 'Uploading Receipts' pill are translucent frosted layers over blurred UI, in the iOS 26 manner; no tab bar visible
density: low-medium; generous 20-24pt padding, ~56pt rows, one chart and three sections on the home
layout: Home: 'Mercury balance' label, big balance, 30D selector with inflow/outflow, edge-to-edge area chart, then sections 'Tasks' and 'Cards' with chevron headers. Move Money: title, horizontal pill actions (Send filled, Request, Deposit), 'Payments' list (Inbox, Needs Approval, Scheduled). Transaction: centred avatar, merchant, amount, action pills, timeline, category/notes/attachments.
navigation: No tab bar in crops; account switcher via title dropdown; section headers with chevrons; sheets for category picking
imagery_and_icons: Thin outline icons in pale circles; initials avatars; card art with line-wave texture; receipt photographs
signature_visual_move: Every amount is set in a light-weight face with small raised cents, on a lavender-tinted canvas that is deliberately not white.
tells_present: Purple, indigo, violet (owned lavender/indigo system; flags a false-positive risk for the tell)

direction_fit.why: The text record (from a web-derived teardown) says dark #0F0F14 with purple glow. Every store screenshot is light mode on a lavender-tinted canvas. The other Cinematic Dark Data signatures hold: a tinted non-neutral canvas, a custom face at an unusual light weight, calibrated balance, separate semantic colours, chart at the top of home. Treat it as a light variant; the 'dark' part is unverified.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Balance '$12,582,210.27' regular weight ~2x body, left-aligned under a regular label 'Mercury balance'; cents raised as superscript at ~55% size; $ full size, no space. The superscript-cents anatomy repeats on every list amount ('$5,000.00', '$128.32', '–$12,740.00', '–$14.31'), but the card limit panel uses inline cents ('$4,000.00', '–$3,215.00'), an inconsistency. Negatives use a true minus with no red: outflows are ink. Flow summary: '↗ $2.2M' with a green arrow and '↘ –$1.4M' with a pink-red arrow, abbreviated to millions. 'Available to spend $484.58' in green. Tabular: unsure. Chart: lavender line with a lavender-to-transparent gradient fill, edge to edge, no axes, with a '30D ▾' period dropdown. Spend progress: stacked indigo (posted) and lavender (pending) bar with dot legend. Recurring payment card shows a progress ring '7 of 8'. No amount entry or confirm screen shown.
